summary: Expand scope_providers from [] to include ALPACA_BASIC, ALPACA_HISTORICAL, MARKETDATA_APP_FREE, and FRANKFURTER_ECB_FX. ALPACA_BASIC was already a candidate_provider, but candidate status is not scope; adding it to scope_providers also requires separate Owner entitlement attestation. Adapters are implemented and tested with mock transports; no live request has been made. No provider is activated by this proposal alone.

activation_prerequisites_per_provider: Owner verifies actual account entitlement for each provider
Owner attests display_permitted, calculation_permitted, derived_value_permitted, cache_permitted
Owner records entitlement_verified=true in scope_providers entry in ODR_UPI_MARKET_DATA_004.json
For ALPACA_BASIC and ALPACA_HISTORICAL: credential stored in Windows Credential Manager as ACASH/MARKET_DATA/<provider_id>
For MARKETDATA_APP_FREE: MARKETDATA_CONTRACT_VERIFIED set to True after live response confirmed; credential stored
For FRANKFURTER_ECB_FX: FRANKFURTER_CONTRACT_VERIFIED set to True after live response confirmed
For each provider: contract_verified in REGISTRY updated to True in market_authority.py after live response recorded
owner_decision_wording: To activate one or more of these providers, the Owner must: (1) verify personal entitlement and exchange-level rights for each provider's plan, (2) set entitlement_verified, display_permitted, calculation_permitted, derived_value_permitted to true in a scope_providers entry, (3) commit the amendment to ODR_UPI_MARKET_DATA_004.json with ratified_by=OWNER and ratified_on=<date>, (4) for contract-unverified providers, record a real response and set the VERIFIED flag in providers.py.
not_authorized_by_this_proposal: Marking any right as VERIFIED without Owner-supplied evidence
Activating any live network request (adapters gate on MARKETDATA_CONTRACT_VERIFIED and FRANKFURTER_CONTRACT_VERIFIED)
